[LGRA.22.5] **Import aliasing.** `import` must support an `as` alias so that two
schemas of the same NFC name from different libraries can both be brought into
bare local scope: `from b import Sensor as BSensor`. The compiler must reject a
program that brings two distinct schemas into scope under the same NFC name
without an alias, with `DS_VALIDATE_IMPORT_NAME_COLLISION`. The library-qualified form `lib.Schema` ([LGRA.22.4]) already
distinguishes the two by their library; aliasing is for **bare** local use.
